note: Fixture group sidecar for the --only tests. Shaped like a real annotation file: prose keys sit beside the mapping, and the parser must ignore them rather than object. Rows 1 and 4 are deliberately unannotated — a sidecar describes the rows it has an opinion about, not a partition of the set.

groups.gap-cost: Queries about what an option costs. Two rows.
groups.bounding-negative: Queries that should NOT trigger, bounding the description's edge. Two rows.
